description: Cropster sync options and status stored on products

cropster_enabled.description: Send this product to Cropster when Products to send is set to marked products

cropster_package_size.description: Package size used when no variant option holds one, e.g. 250g or 12 oz

cropster_review_state.description: REVIEWED or UNREVIEWED; unreviewed products must be reviewed in Cropster before production

cropster_synced_at.description: Last time the product was sent to Cropster

cropster_error.description: Why the last sync failed or the product was not sent
